title: Retro Robot Portrait
description: A close-up portrait of a large vintage-style robot with a weathered red and metallic body. The robot has a rectangular glowing blue screen for an eye, large circular side speakers, and a red-lit rectangular mouth panel, set against a hazy industrial cityscape background.
prompt: Close-up portrait of a massive weathered retro robot made of red and steel panels, featuring a rectangular glowing cyan eye screen on its forehead, large rounded side speakers, riveted metal construction, and a red illuminated mouth grill, standing in front of a faded dystopian industrial city with smokestacks under an overcast sky, detailed texture and atmospheric perspective
